newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hyundai signs pact to build Israel Electric jetty.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai signs pact to build Israel Electric jetty.

text.p: Israel Electric Corp said it signed a contract on Sunday with South Korea's Hyundai Heavy Industries Co Ltd for construction of an $87 million jetty for unloading coal.
The jetty, serving two power plants south of the town of Ashkelon on the Mediterranean coast, is due to be completed in 30 months, the Electric Corp said.
Hyundai won the contract in an international tender in March.
The jetty will be built two km offshore and will be linked to the plants by a bridge. It will handle six to seven million tonnes of coal a year, at up to 4,500 tonnes an hour, the Electric Corp said.
One of the two power plants is being built. The other gets its coal by train from Ashdod port.
The Electric Corp said the jetty would save $10 million annually in transport costs.
